rationale: I read the opening complete-cell capex paragraph, two-to-three-times context, body share, table and payback illustration together. The one bound contiguous passage preserves third-to-half robot share,12..24months in multi-shift operation and the24..36 single-shift/lower-throughput qualification, including labour plus damage/throughput savings in the vendor formula. The local calculator instead uses chosen2.5 and24 and only modeled labour value; these are explicit reader disclosures, not source quotations or measured outcomes. Two excerpts initially violated the native one-pair rule; the final single contiguous passage includes both and all intervening context without changing source text. Release integration review: the main-only 2021-2024 hyphen changes whole-article identity but no economics claim or source passage. The original seven-part AND inventory, source provenance, original/current tuples, formulas and outputs remain identical. I checked the actual fresh release numeric and static-export browser runs at default, minimum, maximum, Reset and mobile default; all seven input domains, independent readouts, elapsed-hour wording, capital-only scope, Axe and error checks passed. New receipts bind the current article and checker without altering historical execution times or receipts. This is integrator review, not independent project acceptance.

inventory.text: EVST's inspected guide does not publish fixed list prices; its quoted bands are complete-cell budgets, not a $25k–$80k robot-arm range.
Any retained calculator sourcing of 2–3x complete-cell/arm ratio and 12–24 month multi-shift guidance remains a vendor statement, not a chosen-value certificate.
The calculator's $80000 robotCost is an authored example, with $20000–$250000 range/5000 step, not a reported price; other model defaults and chosen horizon remain explicit assumptions.
At fixed other example inputs, changing robotCost changes total cell capital, capital cost per modeled pick and modeled payback according to the existing formula.

The real mounted calculator at robotCost20000, other authored defaults fixed, shows the chosen-price disclosure and independently checked capital cost, cost/pick, payback, verdict, picks and elapsed-hour breakdown. Required observations:min. The original mounted-disclosure obligation survives across all three price groups; Reset restores all seven defaults.
